coverage_rules: Reference and held-out records must cover at least eight distinct PDB entries.
Every comparison uses an exact SIFTS or explicit residue-equivalence map over UniProt ABL1 242-495 with at least 90 percent coverage.
Every reference has experimental provenance and independent state evidence.
Human ABL1 only: every record maps to UniProt P00519. Murine ABL1 (P00520) entries are excluded, because mixing accessions breaks the residue-equivalence basis the mask depends on.

Two records in one stratum must differ by more than minimum_opposite_state_margin_A (0.25 A) in CA RMSD over the mask. Records closer than the gated margin are not independent evidence: the panel cannot distinguish them by the quantity it gates on.

State is assigned from evidence independent of the gated geometry - bound-ligand binding mode, activation-loop phosphorylation, or cited experimental annotation - never from the RMSD comparison the module performs.

Structures whose kinase domain is held inactive by quaternary assembly rather than by domain conformation (SH3-SH2 clamped with the myristoyl groove occupied) are not eligible as inactive records. The mask cannot represent the mechanism that inactivates them.

conformational_state.aggregate_gate_note: correct_interpretable_coverage_per_state_min is the one gate that is not per case: it is a fraction over a stratum's records. The runner's stratum_state already requires every case and control to pass, which is stricter, so this floor binds only once records are permitted to be unresolved and still pass. It is recorded here as declared and is not yet enforced anywhere; enforcing it needs an aggregate step in run_execution.main, not a per-case check.
conformational_state.decision_basis: ABL_STATE_ATLAS_PANEL_SCOPE.draft.md and ABL_RECORD_SELECTION.draft.md, both written before any record was curated. Frozen before curation.

gate_kinds.note: max_best_reference_rmsd_A is not a result about conformation. It is the condition under which a result is allowed to exist, so a green panel reads as two scientific results plus a separation check and an interpretability bound, not as four scientific results.

independent_state_evidence.activation_loop_phosphorylation: Phosphotyrosine (PTR) is present in ten pool entries, all on the dfg_in_like side and none on the other. This orients the strata rather than any assumption about which cluster is which.
independent_state_evidence.ligand_binding_mode: Type II compounds extend past the gatekeeper into the back pocket that exists only when DFG is out. Measured as the ATP-site ligand centroid in a common frame: type I 0.2-3.9 A from reference, type II 6.0-10.3 A, with no overlap.
independent_state_evidence.why_not_geometry: Deriving the stratum from the same RMSD the module computes is circular and is how a false-positive gate passes for the wrong reason.

not_measured: Biological activity. Structural resemblance to a reference is not catalytic state.
The autoinhibited assembly. The SH3-SH2 clamp lies outside the 242-495 mask entirely.
Myristoyl-groove occupancy. The pocket is inside the mask but occupancy is a ligand, and a CA RMSD cannot register whether a pocket is filled.
Murine ABL1. P00520 entries are excluded from the pool.
DFG and alphaC spatial labels in the Dunbrack/Kincore sense. This is a two-sided RMSD comparison, not a conformational classification.
conformational_state.recorded_value_note: best_rmsd_A and margin_A are compared against the recorded expectation at this tolerance. It is deliberately not bit-level: the membrane panel recorded expectations in an environment that matched neither CI runner, so a bit-level reproduction gate had no environment in which it could hold. 0.001 A is far below the 0.25 A margin the panel gates on and far above float noise.

state_axis.basis: ABL1 presents at least three states where a two-sided reference set allows two. DFG-out with a type II inhibitor, DFG-in with a type I inhibitor or ADP or a phosphorylated activation loop, and an assembled autoinhibited form whose kinase domain is DFG-in while the molecule is inactive. Labelling the third state by activity would produce a confident opposite-state call for a structurally correct answer.
state_axis.measured: Backbone clustering over the mask separates dfg_in_like from dfg_out_like at within-group median 1.30 A against between-group median 5.09 A, localised to UniProt 382-397 (activation loop, immediately C-terminal to DFG) at mean 16.4 A and 274-279 (beta3-alphaC) at mean 5.2 A.
state_axis.naming_note: A rename to dfg_in_like / dfg_out_like was applied on 2026-09-01 and reverted the same day: the module validates reference states against its own vocabulary, so panel strata that diverge from it would have to be translated somewhere, and a translation layer between a panel and the module it gates is a place for the two to disagree silently. The distinction is carried by this document instead, which is what gate semantics are for.
state_axis.rule: Strata are named active and inactive because state_atlas.core hardcodes STATES = {active, inactive} for a reference set and emits active_like / inactive_like. The names are the module's vocabulary. What they denote here is the conformation of the kinase domain over UniProt 242-495 - DFG-in-like and DFG-out-like - and not biological activity. A record is assigned by conformation, never by whether the molecule is catalytically active.

not_required.mixed_reported: mixed applies to ensembles and trajectories. Every Mark 1 record is a single experimental frame.
not_required.unresolved_reported: Requiring an actually unresolved case would force the panel to carry a case chosen for being hard to call. Whether one belongs here is a curation decision, not a coverage rule; see ABL_RECORD_SELECTION.draft.md section 6.

coverage_requirements.rationale: both_reference_states_compared is the discriminating one. A margin computed against a single side is not a margin, and the module would still emit a call, so a panel that never witnessed a two-sided comparison could pass while measuring nothing about separation.

missing_evidence_behavior.rule: Declared per stratum so a legitimately absent leg is stated, not tolerated. Neither stratum may be missing a leg: a StateAtlas call without its alignment map or without both sides of the reference set is not a weaker measurement, it is a different one.
missing_evidence_behavior.unresolved_is_not_missing: An unresolved frame is a reported result, not missing evidence. The module counts it in every denominator and the panel does the same; a case may be unresolved and still pass, and only the per-stratum coverage floor limits how many.
missing_evidence_behavior.why_the_panel_marker_is_expected: state-atlas withholds qualification_v2_held_out_panel on every run: the module declining to claim a qualification this panel has not yet earned. It is expected in both strata, and an empty list here would fail every record.
